card.name: Punctuation and links in label cross-references
card.fires_on: Mostly the period inside section cross-references like (2.2, 2.3), and the word "known" in "with and without known hypersensitivity" in drug label warnings. Also scattered single words such as a closing parenthesis or colon in label headings.

modes.description: The word "known" after "with and without" or "without" in anaphylaxis warnings.

modes.label: Label heading punctuation
modes.description: A colon or closing parenthesis right after a warning heading name.

card.plain: It fires on small bits of label structure, like the dot in section numbers and the word "known" in allergy warnings.
